title: Tuscaloosa Tornado Damage
description: B-roll of Alabama National Guardsmen performing search and rescue missions in Tuscaloosa, Ala., after tornadoes devastated areas throughout the city. Interviews with Sgt. Nicholas Hubbard and Spc. Lavante Williams of the Alabama National Guard. Video by Tech Sgt. John Anderson and Staff Sgt. Chalanda Roberts.
